scope: Passive local Play2Code capture, strict H04 owner-manual benchmark, sealed reconstruction export, one isolated generated replay, and independent closed-save verification

assessment.native_capture_and_export: GO within the isolated Minecraft 26.3 test client
assessment.generated_bcl_replay: GO via R33 on the canonical fixture

architecture.recorder: Local F9/F10 passive observer; owns no key, camera, hotbar, packet or world mutation
architecture.remote_exclusion: Recording requires the authenticated control endpoint to be disabled; endpoint activation invalidates capture
architecture.exporter: Offline validation and mapping through default_commands() and compile_bcl()
architecture.execution_stack: Authenticated BCL/runtime/registered skills/native Minecraft actions; no second planner or hidden controller
architecture.independent_truth: Operation postconditions plus native inspection and closed-save voxel verification

historical_native_graphical_smoke.claim_boundary: Capture/export smoke only; not the H04 house or R33 replay verdict

qualification_boundary.qualified: One sealed H04 reconstruction on one fresh canonical Minecraft 26.3 fixture
not_qualified: Broad dimensions, slabs, fluids, caves or modpacks
Strict Test-B repeatability beyond its retained historical result

privacy: Raw timelines, recording identity, UUIDs, actor tokens, precise observations, saves, journals, credentials, certificates and private keys remain private and outside this evidence file and distributable bundles.
